title: Environment separation: Restrict browser-exposed values to explicitly public names and never put secrets in NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables or next.config env.
description: Next.js 16 production operations lesson for environment separation with a broken starter, instructor repair, negative test and local-only verification.
objectives: Restrict browser-exposed values to explicitly public names and never put secrets in NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables or next.config env.
Identify independent production security and runtime acceptance requirements.
rubric: I can explain the Next.js 16 rules for environment separation.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.05.01 failing starter.
I can distinguish deterministic model tests from real runtime or HTTP qualification.
